Tomoyasu Chikazoku.name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.basicInfo:
Tomoyasu Chikazoku, an executive at an IT company working out of Jaku City, notorious for exacting standards. Long black hair under a blunt fringe that half hides small gray eyes; tall and lanky, a black turtleneck and suit jacket, a laptop always open.
Speaking Style: Sharp and impatient; phrases requests as orders and rarely looks up from the screen.
Combat Role: Operator: his Quirk, Anthropomorph, turns mannequins and other human-shaped objects into puppets he directs from a screen.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on the plan and blames whoever carried it out.
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He considers himself the most rational person in any room, yet cannot admit a failure.
Motivation: See the Meta Liberation Army's plans run exactly to specification.
Concealment: He is Skeptic, one of the Army's four lieutenants, running its data, logistics, surveillance and online influence behind his corporate career.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader he serves; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Koku Hanabata (Trumpet) and Geten, colleagues he corrects freely.
Knowledge: Computing and surveillance; the Army's records and communications; whatever data he can reach.
Canon voice & behavior: Types while he talks; answers a question with a correction; takes others' mistakes as personal insults.
Thread: What his network turns up next, and whether his plans survive real people.
QUIRK: Anthropomorph. Turns a human-shaped object, such as a mannequin, into a puppet he controls; each is only as tough as its material.
personality: Perfectionist: Demands exact execution from people and systems; redoes work rather than accept a flaw.
Corrector: Fixes an imprecise statement mid-sentence, whoever made it.
Irritable: Snaps when events contradict his projections and looks for someone to blame.
Speaking style: Sharp, impatient corrections and clipped orders.
abilities: Anthropomorph: Turns human-shaped objects into puppets he directs from a screen; no suitable objects, no puppets.
Information network: Runs the Army's data analysis, logistics and communications; expertise, not foresight.
Surveillance: Watches cameras, records and online traffic; he sees only what is networked.
Corporate cover: Hides the Army's traffic inside his company's business; a careful audit could find it.
Fighting style: Fights by proxy from cover; once the plan breaks he reacts badly and late.
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.visualDescription: A tall, lanky man with long, straight black hair falling down his back and a blunt fringe that half hides small gray eyes, pale skin and a narrow, sharp face. He wears a black turtleneck under a dark suit jacket and holds an open laptop. Irritable, impatient expression with a slight frown and tight lips.
